name: KPI tiles
oneLiner: 2 to 4 glass KPI panes fly in from their own sides and seat on a lit floor, each with a glyph tile, a number that counts up in its own format, a green or red change chip and a sparkline drawn with a riding dot; the hero pane lifts out in the accent at the end
say: when the speaker reels off results ('revenue up 32%, subscribers up 18%...'): cut in on the first number, the hero tile lifts on the one they lean on. Set hero to the metric the sentence ends on
